num_facilities: <int> Number of potential facility locations that may be opened.
num_customers: <int> Number of customers whose demands must be served.
num_scenarios: <int> Number of demand scenarios representing uncertainty.
total_capacity: <int> Combined service capacity across all potential facilities.
max_total_demand: <int> Highest aggregate customer demand among all scenarios.

facilities.x_coordinates: <list[float], length num_facilities> Horizontal coordinate of each potential facility on the service region grid.
facilities.y_coordinates: <list[float], length num_facilities> Vertical coordinate of each potential facility on the service region grid.
facilities.fixed_costs: <list[int], length num_facilities> One-time cost incurred for opening each facility.
facilities.capacities: <list[int], length num_facilities> Maximum total flow each facility can ship to customers if opened.

customers.x_coordinates: <list[float], length num_customers> Horizontal coordinate of each customer on the service region grid.
customers.y_coordinates: <list[float], length num_customers> Vertical coordinate of each customer on the service region grid.

routing_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][num_customers]> Per-unit cost of shipping goods from each facility to each customer.

scenarios.num_scenarios: <int> Number of demand scenarios representing uncertainty.
scenarios.probabilities: <list[float], length num_scenarios> Likelihood of each demand scenario occurring.
scenarios.demands: <list[list[int]], shape [num_scenarios][num_customers]> Quantity of goods each customer requires under each scenario.
